full_sentence: Although the plan seemed risky, they decided to proceed anyway.
acceptable_variants: they still decided to move forward.
they chose to go ahead nonetheless.

options.text: they cancelled the project at once.
options.why_wrong: Cancelling the project is a logical consequence of risk, not a contrast. 'Although' signals that the main clause goes against the expectation set by the first part.

options.text: the risks were clearly visible to everyone.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of risk instead of providing a contrasting action after 'although'.

options.text: the plan was written in March.
options.why_wrong: This adds an unrelated detail and does not contrast with the risky plan described in the stem.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners should avoid using a cause-and-effect result, because the contrast is the point of the connector. Note that the subject and verb of the main clause are normal affirmative past forms.
translation: Хоча план здавався ризикованим, вони вирішили все одно продовжити.
